text: Compare agent-tool and direct session-shell execution after editing .envrc without approval.

content.text: Wrapped shell: approval requested and no output file created. POST /api/session/:id/shell: output file created with the previous environment despite the changed unapproved .envrc.
At OpenCode b8aa08f2, a registered-shell wrapper cannot enforce direnv approval on the direct session-shell endpoint, which bypasses that wrapper.
